status: prospective protocol fixed after R27 reviewer1's applicability blocker, before implementing or executing the new endpoint
motivation: One complete specified producer/receiver instance is needed; repeating response-deadline stubs or more arbitrary-prefix simulations would not discharge its WU-robust enclosure.
instance: A new executable one-line read endpoint, not the historical native HUSH cache. A valid preloaded clean readable byte, tag64, epoch7. WU input is a separate always-accepted lane, at most one update per receiver tick; response is a dedicated always-consumed lane. Reads latch the byte and cancel an active timer. A two-register response pipeline advances only on cache-clock boundaries, with no analytical response target/deadline assignment. This implementation and a refinement proof establish its own timing; they do not establish conformance of native gem5 or physical RTL.
event_order: At each receiver tick: revoke; valid-only WU load/rearm; enabled periodic decrement/expiry; client actions including read/tag decision/cancel/latch; response pipeline output then shift at a cache boundary. Every pending read is already snapshotted, so later WU/data changes do not alter its response or pipeline latency. Old queued expiry records do not exist: there is exactly one physical countdown register.
producer_argument: For an accepted read at s, register0 latches immediately before the boundary action. At a=p*ceil(s/p), it moves to register1; at a+p register1 emits. Thus c=p*ceil(s/p)+p follows from register transitions, not a scheduled formula. Client one-outstanding discipline prevents overwrite; the dedicated sink accepts immediately. WU/revocation/timer paths do not modify pipeline control, so WU cannot delay a snapshotted response. Non-expiry causes revoke rather than silently preserving a certificate.
refinement_argument: After WU at r, the countdown equals K minus the number of decrement boundaries already visited while it remained enabled, and therefore expires at F(r). Read-hit cancellation disables it; invalid WU cannot resurrect. Data values do not affect control. Relate pending register IDs/data to accepted read snapshots, and the sole active timer to the latest surviving arm. First-failure induction combines the admitted producer relation with positive observer slack, rather than assuming all reads hit to derive their schedule.
policy_and_entry: Use p9,q16,s0=5 and the existing public MemTest five unchanged function bodies. Start valid, timer disabled, both pipeline registers empty, client outstanding set empty and waitResponse=false. The repeating source-service phases are5,21,37,70 modulo81. Old policy K2/P27/phi6 has exact observer slack12; a fresh-entry query K3/P18/phi2 from the retained g27 payload has slack4. Response-stage/cache clock facts are fixed, counter policy is queried separately. Installing a policy requires fresh runtime entry or separate transition proof; this is not hot retuning of an old runtime token.
source_coupled_cases: For each of the two safe policies, run all4096 binary WU words of length12 repeated over at least8 service intervals, plus no-WU/every-tick and every distinct zero/one/two-WU subset in the initial ticks5..86. Drive actual unchanged MemTest functions from the event queue; endpoint pipeline output calls the real extracted recvTimingResp body. Compare services, receipts, IDs and byte snapshots against the independent recurrence; assert no source read fails, no pipeline overwrite and all callbacks accepted. These are finite corroboration, not the unbounded proof.
unbounded_control_check: BFS the actual endpoint state transition under both WU input bits using time modulo lcm(81,P), the periodic read phases and finite register/countdown state. Use zero data (control is data-independent by code/proof) and cyclic service IDs that are never reused while pending. Check read validity, register occupancy and response phase/identity; every reachable state and both WU successors are retained. This is a finite model check of the new specified implementation under the derived client control trace, supplementing the separate source/control refinement argument.
negative_cases: K2/P18/phi2 with only WU38 must expire56 and reject read70. Invalid preload must fail entry. Reject clock p10 versus record p9, epoch mismatch, shared WU/response lane, revoked token, exceeded horizon, and unproved hot policy change. No failed binding may return a safe answer. Preserve each negative trace and result.
scope_and_overflow: New own source/model/proof and compile/run evidence only; no new GPU or native gem5 acquisition, hardware timing/area/power, cache-data-coherence or global protocol claim. Logical implementation refinement assumes no integer overflow; runtime records enforce a finite tick/ID horizon, and the mathematical periodic/inductive argument is explicitly distinguished from bounded machine execution. Standing authorization covers this same-scope minimal own executable model and checks after independent fresh rerun.
